maps.vieta: Vieta jumping: fix B^y and exponents, view A^x+B^y=C^z as a relation in (A,C) and jump to a second root
maps.norm_split: factor C^z-B^y over Z[zeta] when gcd(y,z)=d>1 and descend to the factor equation with exponents (x,y/d,z/d)
maps.frey_isogeny: pass to the 2-isogenous Frey curve: (a,b,c)->(( a-b)^2, 4ab, (a+b)^2) i.e. c^2=(a-b)^2+4ab, and ask whether perfect-power shape persists
maps.abc_square: the map (a,b,c)->(a^2, 2ab+b^2, c^2) or (a^2,b^2,c^2-2ab) keeping two terms perfect powers
maps.belyi_pull: pull back along a Belyi map of degree n preserving {0,1,inf}: (a:b:c)->(a^n : c^n-a^n : c^n) style, keeping power structure on two terms
maps.exponent_gcd: if p | x, replace A by A^(x/p): reduces to prime/4 exponents (known reduction) then descend via signature-specific parametrisation to a smaller solution of a DIFFERENT signature
maps.pss_chain: the chain 2^7+17^3=71^2 -> 17^7+76271^3=21063928^2 sharing base 17: a map reusing a base with a new exponent
maps.infinite_descent_height: classical infinite descent on height via 2-descent on the Frey curve E: y^2=x(x-a)(x+b), using that E has full 2-torsion
